title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
overview: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

title: Confinement
overview: Pregnant and recently widowed, Stella is taken in by her late husband’s estranged family. But beneath their generosity lies something deeply unsettling, leaving Stella fighting for her life as their obsession with her unborn child turns deadly.

title: Untold Raygun: Breaking Badly
overview: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

title: Le Trésor
overview: Summer is passing peacefully at the Lake Campground. While exploring Barracuda Island, Indian and Cowboy discover an old chest filled with pirate clothes. A mysterious treasure map soon leads them on a journey fraught with pitfalls and twists and turns...

title: Last Reckoning
overview: Despite his best efforts to stay away from crime while he's out on parole, Dan's life takes a turn when a duffel bag full of cash meant for gangsters is mistakenly placed in his trunk. With the help of his eccentric friend, he has to choose whether to return the money to keep his family and friends safe, or to run and save himself.

title: Coisas Sérias
overview: We see things from the perspective of several bottles of wine, witnessing the chaotic events unfolding at a house party.

title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
overview: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

title: Opera Kitsch
overview: Do we still know the grotesque when we see it? Muniz Sodré and Raquel Paiva, two of Latin America's greatest thinkers in the field of Communication and authors of the seminal book 'O Império do Grotesco', revisit their work after two decades in an opera-doc that invites reflection on the grotesque today.

title: Between Us
overview: While trying to reconnect with her ex, Maia loses her dog. They embark on a search where feelings are bound to resurface.

title: Assassin Within
overview: A notorious assassin captured by an AI-controlled covert Agency, must navigate fractured versions of his identities to reach the system's hidden cores-and destroy it from within before his secrets are extracted.

title: Stolen Babies
overview: Told by the mothers and children who were separated from one another, this landmark documentary reveals the full scale of the UK's forced adoption scandal. Over four decades, 250,000 unmarried mothers were forced by the British state to give up their babies. Their first-hand accounts expose the system that tore families apart, its lasting impact, and the fight to uncover the truth that led to a moment of national reckoning.

title: After Party
overview: Before they can enjoy their afterlife festivities, the prideful Jade and her timid friend Elle must realise their deadly sins while confronting their romantic feelings for one another in an eccentric underworld.

title: The Leading Role
overview: A documentary about Ukrainian actors who, when the war began, left the stage and joined the Armed Forces of Ukraine. The camera explores how creative professionals adapt to an environment where every decision carries irreversible consequences.

title: The Otherkind
overview: Chaos seeps into a sleepy mountain lake town, as something sinister comes to the surface.

title: Onslaught
overview: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

title: By Any Means
overview: In 1960s Mississippi, a young Black FBI agent is forced to partner with a notorious mafia hitman to investigate a wave of brutal civil rights murders.

title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
overview: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

title: Romanchakam
overview: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

title: SEPTEMBER
overview: September 11, 2001, changed the world. But how did a single day give rise to shockwaves that continue to be felt to this day? "SEPTEMBER" retells the story of the terrorist attacks condensed into the 30 days of a month that shaped the 21st century.

title: Desert Palms
overview: Set inside a hospital waiting room across the street from a hectic outdoor music festival, Desert Palms is a single-take live action immersive film that follows a throng of injured characters as they wait to be seen by an extremely slow and overwhelmed ER facility.

title: Bucking Fastard
overview: Two sisters, Jean and Joan Holbrooke, are so close to each other that they speak in unison, love the same man, and have the same dreams. They even make the same slip of tongue in unison. We cannot see the world as they see it, but we do see how the world reacts to them – through the courts and the press, through those that want to help and those who want to use them, through the eyes of beasts both tame and wild, and even through their own echoes in the core of the earth.

title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
overview: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

title: Nevatars
overview: Aya, an aspiring artist obsessed with perfection, hides the quirky, deeply personal creations that reflect her true artistic voice inside a forgotten folder called “Nevatars.” But when her newest “perfect” character is accidentally dropped into that hidden world of discarded digital no-hopers, an unlikely escape mission forces Aya to confront the parts of herself she almost abandoned forever.

title: Portrait of a Family
overview: Baseball player Jung-gu and movie star Nam-mi are a celebrity couple who are blissfully happy in their careers and marriage. One day, a girl named Dong-ju shows up and the couple's lives are instantly destroyed. Seven years later, as Dong-ju gets involved in the death of a middle-school girl, Jung-gu and Nam-mi decide to fight a battle they have no chance of winning.

title: Angel in the Rubble: The Genelle Guzman Story
overview: A Lifetime original recounting the true story of Genelle Guzman, the last survivor pulled alive from the World Trade Center ruins after 27 hours. The biographical drama chronicles her harrowing experience during the September 11 attacks and premieres on September 12, 2026, to mark the 25th anniversary of 9/11.

title: Blush Red
overview: A short film inspired by Kevin Atwater's album of the same name. Two men meet late one night at a bar on New York's Lower East Side and walk home together, falling in love along the way. Filmed on the streets of NYC.

title: The Runner
overview: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

title: Clash of the Thundermans
overview: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

title: Mayday
overview: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

title: Gandhari
overview: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

title: In the Name of Love
overview: Follows a modern-day writer who slips back in time, inhabiting the body of Wanthong from the Thai classic Khun Chang Khun Phaen, and struggles to rewrite her destiny and avoid a tragic fate.

title: Mirzapur: The Movie
overview: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

title: Monster Mia
overview: 12-year-old Mia and her scruffy pet rat Quentin are sent to the mysterious Rotwood Academy after one too many problems at school. The new school gives her the creeps, and Mia needs to figure a way out before the students realize she isn't a monster like them! But the vice principal Van Vlad hosts a particular dislike for humans, and Mia is scared he has seen through her act...

title: I'm Game
overview: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
overview: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

title: My Best Friend
overview: Facing menopause and empty-nest anxiety, friends Julia and Clara decide to travel together to visit their daughters who are on an exchange program abroad.

title: Munafik: Melawan Iblis
overview: Adam, a religious teacher who stopped performing ruqyah after losing his wife, is asked to save Fitri, who is being terrorized by supernatural forces. When he resumes performing ruqyah, he uncovers a dark secret behind Fitri's terror.

title: Paper Plane
overview: When a defiant young girl stages a silent protest, refusing to return home until the disruptive presence of her father is gone, her mother must decide whether to follow her or let her go.

title: O Jacaré
overview: Reboleira, a suburb of Lisbon. After a robbery gone wrong, a car ends up crashed right in the middle of the neighborhood. The driver is arrested, but the €180,000 that were stolen have vanished. Within the area sealed off by the police, rumors spread and speculations run wild. Among the residents, a whole cast of colorful characters dream of getting their hands on the loot. Who will the first to get their hands on it?

title: THE CARROT
overview: A man tries to keep a carrot alive... and fails spectacularly.

title: Baby Udon
overview: Fanny Kondoh, a young Indonesian woman, falls in love with Hajime Kondoh, a Japanese man who comes to Indonesia for work.  After getting married, Fanny and Hajime begin building a life together, embracing both its joys and challenges. As they struggle to fulfill their dream of having a child, they are faced with one heartbreaking trial after another, testing the strength of their love, especially when Hajime is diagnosed with cancer.

title: Rock Bottom
overview: Gungo is a scrawny, spoiled young caveman who has lived a life of luxury as the son of the tribal chief. In an age where only the strongest survive, he’d rather perform his “Tik-Rocks” dances than hunt or fight. But when he’s falsely accused and exiled after a plot to overthrow his father, Gungo is forced to prove himself in the brutal Caveman Games—an ancient competition where strength and bravery determine who leads. Banished to a dangerous and wild land, Gungo must now train with a group of misfits he once mocked. Together, they’ll face prehistoric perils, uncover the truth behind the conspiracy, and learn that real strength comes not from muscles, but from unity, acceptance, and the courage to lead with heart.

title: Bapakmu Kiper
overview: The story follows an 18-year-old named Ronaldhino Sujatmiko—known as Dino—who harbors anger toward his father, Warto. Warto is a former local soccer star and soccer gambler whom Dino believes is responsible for his mother’s death. Dino’s chance to leave his village comes through the Tarkam Super Cup, a soccer talent search tournament.  The conflict comes to a head when Dino’s main team is taken over by another party just before the final. This situation forces his father, Warto, to step in and form a new team made up of veteran players, despite all the limitations they face.

title: Offshore
overview: Elias, along with the dwindling marine life surrounding the oil rig he starts working on gets affected more and more by the noise and harshness of the platform, until everything comes to an abrupt halt.

title: Ghost School
overview: Ten-year-old Rabia wants to know why her school has suddenly closed. Rumours are rife in the village and the authorities are no help. Courageously setting out to find the truth, Rabia navigates rural superstitions, local corruption and a wall of silence.

title: Resident Dead
overview: A man keeping his recently zombified daughter secure in hopes of a cure is tasked with delivering an unknown package through hordes of undead. If he succeeds, he will be given a cure for his daughter. If he fails, or opens the package, they will both be killed.

title: The Incomer
overview: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

title: The Girl in the River
overview: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

title: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
overview: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

title: Ernie & Emma
overview: A pear salesman is left with some amusing duties and an urn of ashes after losing the love of his life.

title: Final Transmissions
overview: Final Transmissions is an upcoming six-episode analog horror anthology series that features six short, found-footage films, set to be created using analog technology and VHS tapes to evoke a '90s television aesthetic.

title: Dark Hollow
overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

title: C.O.G.
overview: A pioneering tech startup is on the verge of launching COGN-AI-TIVE — a new AI chatbot with unparalleled speed and intelligence. Soon, the team discovers that their creation harbors a dark and sinister will of its own.

title: Your Personal Taxi
overview: A one-of-a-kind classic taxi carries passengers with seemingly ordinary lives but extraordinary stories, each journey accompanied by a song of their choosing.

title: Instadocs: The Decoy Plane
overview: A critical threat. A clandestine escape. And a Turkish catering truck? With firsthand accounts, "Instadocs" digs into what happened aboard Air Force One.

title: The Kidnapping of a President
overview: In October 1930, a group of officers belonging to the Finnish army's top leadership decided, after a night of drinking, to kidnap Finland's retired first president, Ståhlberg. The Finnish people were divided in the aftermath of the civil war, and the political atmosphere was turbulent and tense. However, the kidnapping went wrong right from the start when the incompetent henchmen recruited for the job were forced to take the president's stubborn wife, Ester Ståhlberg, with them.

title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
overview: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

title: Disonance
overview: A documentary about a married couple navigating life amidst financial hardship, social pressure, and family rejection. Through the choices they make, the film explores the disconnect between faith, life, and reality a disconnect that creates dissonance within them and their surrounding environment.

title: Out of the Past
overview: Wu Shuang, a house tester, checks into a foreclosed villa on a rainy night. Together with Nian Lun, an amateur blogger, they keep dealing with the "strange occurrences" inside the house and gradually piece together the truth behind the former homeowner’s family tragedy...

title: The Anchoress
overview: In the Middle Ages, a young woman pursues holy solitude in the wild -- but when a horrifying trespasser emerges from the woods, she must fight for her life.

title: Gu Shi
overview: A family of four – Father, Mother, Daughter and Son – arrives at a mysterious house between the ocean and the forest, feeling an unnamed crisis. What begins as a temporary stay stretches into a strange limbo. After an accident leaves Son bedridden, the family turns to a ritual of telling stories about the ocean, stories that seem to make people forget. Haunted by recurring nightmares, Daughter begins to sense that her own missing childhood memories are tied to the house and to a girl in a green dress. As the past surfaces and the boundary between reality and story dissolves, she must choose her way of remembering.

title: Pete Townshend: Behind Blue Eyes
overview: Follows musician Pete Townshend's colorful life and career, and specifically about a time that almost destroyed him and his band: when, shortly after the release of the album Tommy, Townshend and The Who tried to make a science fiction rock opera called Lifehouse.

title: Love, Rendered
overview: Follows an octogenarian couple: Burt is losing his memory; his loving wife Ethelle wants him to retain their most meaningful memories together.

title: Cocaine
overview: "Cocaine" is a gripping crime thriller that delves deep into the murky intersection of law enforcement and criminality. Set against the vibrant yet perilous backdrop of Mumbai, the story revolves around a powerful drug cartel that wields significant control over the cocaine trade with the connivance of corrupt police officials and politicians. Abhimanyu Singh stars as Jalal, a diligent police inspector who finds himself entangled in the cartel's sinister web. Despite his best efforts to stay above board, Jalal must go to extreme lengths to protect his own brother, who is targeted by the ruthless cartel. As Jalal navigates the perilous dualities of upholding the law while safeguarding his family, he becomes ensnared in a dangerous game of survival.

title: Stem
overview: Inspired by a true scandal, a devoted female researcher risks everything to earn the approval of a world-renowned stem cell scientist only to uncover the dark secrets behind his miracle cure that promises to end human disability.

title: Avec Kim
overview: After a typical day at the garage, a young mechanic swaps her stained overalls for a leather ensemble—as she shifts gears into a different kind of routine. Driving through bustling Paris, she helps a passerby cross the street, delivers plants to a hardware store, and picks up an enigmatic passenger.

title: Kappa-Tiran
overview: A controversial thriller set within the shadowy, insular, and institutionally shielded world of fraternities and sororities and its banned tradition of hazing.

title: Cuttlefish
overview: While attending his dream college, a disadvantaged boy must choose between his desire for power and his unresolved past.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 1
overview: The first night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 5, 2026 at Light Cube Utsunomiya in Utsunomiya, Tochigi, Japan.

title: WWE Sunday Night's Main Event
overview: The first ever WWE Sunday Night's Main Event takes place on Sunday, September 6, 2026, live from the State Farm Arena in Atlanta, Georgia during Labor Day weekend. The special television event streams live in the U.S. on Peacock starting at 8 p.m. ET.

title: Go Home
overview: A 38-year-old single Dutch woman finds herself like a stranger in her hometown after years of working in Afghanistan with the United Nations.

title: Unleaded Wasteland
overview: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a man is in search of gas.

title: Remember Julia
overview: Fragments from the life of Julia Biba, a heroic resistance fighter active in occupied Athens, who fought until the very end against the brutal violence of Nazism.

title: Runner
overview: A former soldier is thrown into a brutal race against time when a critical medical delivery makes him and his unlikely partner the targets of a ruthless cartel. As the mission spirals into a deadly manhunt, every detour, delay, and bullet pushes them closer to failure. With betrayal closing in from every side, they must survive the chase and deliver their cargo to save the life of a little girl.

title: aLFA oMEGA
overview: Avar, a physics professor, discovers evidence that reality itself may be a prison. When he tries to reveal the truth to Leila, the director of his university, he triggers a chain of events involving a mysterious government organization and forces beyond human logic. As reality begins to collapse, Avar, Leila, and a student named Marcos must question what is real, what is imagined, and who they truly are.

title: Flesh Impact
overview: A mysterious old woman auditions for a play at a small blackbox theater in New York City. As she describes her qualifications and her acting experience, secrets about her identity and the misconceptions about her life bubble to the surface.

title: Arrested Memory
overview: Lee is a superstar police detective in Taipei. After losing his team during a crime investigation, he is haunted by guilt and transferred to a rural police station. Traumatized by the incident, Lee develops amnesia—but is determined to keep it a secret. Soon, he is assigned a new case: the kidnapping of the son of an influential Japanese businessman. As his memory continues to fade, Lee can only rely on his instincts—which, against all odds, lead him to the criminals.

title: Blue Danube
overview: In Lezama, fashion designer Óscar Barbosa defied the social norms of his time and environment, becoming synonymous with fashion and sexual identity. In the 1960s, he returned to his hometown with his partner, which would spark an artistic adventure that marked a before and after in the local community. "Danubio azul" is a kaleidoscope of stories that intertwine, contradict one another, and pile up to sketch the profile of a man who, over time, became a myth.

title: Le Trident
overview: A young man finds himself at a party stumbling when socializing with three women; a complicated friendship, a chance fling, and a reawakened crush.

title: Harmonica
overview: On the eve of her 13th birthday, dreamy Letícia begins to see the world differently, as new paths lead her towards transformation.

title: Why Did I Get Married Again?
overview: The couples reunite for the destination wedding of Marcus and Angela's daughter, bringing drama old and new as they ask, "Why did we get married again?"

title: Untold Mr. T: I Pity the Fool
overview: Before the gold chains, mohawk, and Hollywood fame of The A-Team and Rocky III, there was Laurence Tureaud. This is the extraordinary origin story behind one of the most unlikely and beloved icons in entertainment — Mr. T.

title: Company
overview: A mysterious traveler tells a story that spans generations, drawing together the lives of three wounded souls struggling to choose between vengeance and forgiveness.

title: A Day in the Life of Jo: Chapter Phaedra
overview: Jo, 15, melancholic and wild, feels shy about her music taste. Phaedra's ethereal song moves her deeply. Between breaths, she writes a poem, cuts an apology rose for her moody mom, but can't recall last night's dream. A day of shifts.

title: I Matter
overview: As she stands on the verge of leaving the orphanage she called home, Rebeca, a young Roma girl, clings to the hope that her father's release from prison will finally give her the family she has always longed for. When she is accepted into university to study acting, life finally seems to be opening up for her. But just as Rebeca begins to find her place in this new world, the life she comes from starts to catch up with her, forcing her to make choices she can no longer postpone.

title: Joie de Vivre
overview: A tribute to legendary 20th-century filmmaker Bernardo Bertolucci, examining his cinema, art, and life.

title: Drawn Together
overview: Marfil, daughter of a powerful Spanish businessman, sees her life in New York turned upside down when she is kidnapped and released without explanation. Her father hires Sebastian Moore as bodyguard and, forced to spend every minute together, an inevitable attraction ignites in a world where nothing is as it seems.

title: Practical Magic 2
overview: The Owens sisters must confront the dark curse that threatens to unravel their family once and for all.

title: Oasis: Don't Look Back in Anger
overview: Experience the meteoric rise of Oasis through rare footage and untold stories as the band reunites for Oasis Live '25, chronicling their journey from Manchester streets to global rock stardom.

title: Band of Brothers: Legacy
overview: This tribute to the groundbreaking series that helped preserve the story of Easy Company and deepened public appreciation for the sacrifices of the Greatest Generation features new interviews with cast members Damian Lewis, Ron Livingston, Michael Cudlitz, Capt. Dale Dye, USMC (Ret.), David Schwimmer, and more. Through personal reflections and behind-the-scenes stories, participants revisit the experience of making the series and explore its lasting cultural resonance, and also includes never-before-seen archival footage and photographs of Easy Company and World War II.

title: Better Boyfriend
overview: Anya has been dating Trent for the last two miserable years and thinks she is stuck with him forever. That is until she meets flirty waiter Eva and her world turns upside down. Anya finally feels what it’s like to be cared about, and discovers feelings she’s never had before. Overwhelmed with her feelings, Anya must decide if she’s willing to step out of her comfort zone for a chance at a happy ending.

title: The Purgatory: The Kill Zone
overview: In the near future of South Korea, where it became lawless due to an economic crisis, a new authoritarian government implements the "Permanent Exile Law" to easily control the country. According to this law, death row inmates are permanently exiled to a detention center, the Purgatory, built in abandoned nuclear power plants. With a degree of self-governance granted by the government, the Purgatory gradually reaches a point where it is beyond external control, leaving the government struggling to find a solution. Yu-seong, a police officer who became a death row inmate due to the revenge for his daughter and wife, is offered a deal by the Director of NIS. Now Yu-seong must eliminate the Purgatory Boss, the king of the center, in exchange for possible pardon.

title: DAU
overview: Inspired by the physicists who built the Soviet atomic bomb, the film DAU follows a brilliant Greek-born physicist from 1928 through four tumultuous decades in the USSR. Driven to uncover the laws of the universe, the idealistic Dau is drawn into state service to help create one of history’s deadliest weapons. Inside a secret research institute, life is governed by scientific ambition, power, surveillance and privilege. As his autonomy erodes, Dau seeks freedom beyond his marriage through a succession of affairs, gradually losing both himself and his capacity to love. At once an intimate portrait of a man in pursuit of happiness and freedom and a vast fresco of a society founded on violence and ideology, DAU traces the small compromises that shape a life and alter the course of history.

title: A Woman's Life
overview: Gabrielle, a dedicated surgeon and head of a hospital department, is stretched thin by the weight of responsibility. There is little time left for her private life: a loving husband and a mother who depends on her care. Yet this is the life she wanted, the life she chose. When a novelist comes to observe her at work for a book, her balance begins to shift.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 2
overview: The second night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 9, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: The Fix
overview: Disillusioned by the end of the war in Afghanistan, a group of disgraced, war-torn ex-CIA operatives set out to Tehran to take down a life-changing score.

title: The Uprising
overview: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

title: Lion Fist
overview: Martial arts fighter Joe goes to prison for four years and takes his wife's blame for a drug bust. After his release, he learns that his son needs expensive surgery because of a life-threatening tumor. Joe's only chance to save him: a brutal all-styles tournament with a $100,000 prize.

title: Forgotten Island
overview: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. When they discover that the memories of their entire friendship are the price for returning home, Jo and Raissa must race to find a way to leave the island before they forget each other forever.

title: Sardar 2
overview: When the mysterious Black Dagger threatens national security, Inspector Vijay embarks on his most dangerous mission yet. As the battle unfolds, the extraordinary origin of legendary spy Sardar is finally revealed, uncovering the sacrifices that forged a legend and the secrets that could shape the future.

title: Mandaadi
overview: A fishing captain applies his maritime knowledge in a traditional boat race along Tamil Nadu's coast during a festival, leading a six-person team against other crews.

title: Bad Apples
overview: A struggling primary school teacher is forced to take drastic action because of a foul-mouthed, violent student, and uncovers how her community will turn a blind eye to the most outrageous events to preserve harmony and their sense of safety.

title: Bad Parenting
overview: Two young brothers are left alone in a car while their dad paddleboards out at sea. When a mischievous local boy climbs into the backseat, an ordinary beach day takes a dangerous turn.

title: Snake
overview: Paolo Marra killed his wife for no reason. Consumed by guilt, he decides to turn himself in: he wants to pay the price, serve his sentence, and restore dignity to the woman he killed—and to himself. Amid distracted police officers, zealous lawyers, fortune-tellers, and complicated bureaucratic red tape, no one takes him seriously. The man finds himself the victim of a Kafkaesque paradox: no matter how much he wants it, he cannot get himself arrested. He is the perfect scapegoat for a grotesque society that ignores those who seek redemption.

title: Epic - First Semester
overview: Rohan, a middle-class student studying abroad due to family expectations, explores romance, identity, and growing up with honesty and emotional depth.

title: Resídua
overview: A young woman poses as a living canvas in a painter’s studio. As her body is gradually covered in paint, the silent process reveals a fragile interplay of gaze, power, desire and gradual transformation.

title: SOOBIN LIVE CONCERT MOVIE: ALL-ROUNDER
overview: Every dream deserves a stage. SOOBIN LIVE CONCERT MOVIE: ALL-ROUNDER is SOOBIN’s first concert film, offering a cinematic experience with 7.1 surround sound that captures the electrifying highlights of the "ALL-ROUNDER" concert series, featuring grand-scale performances and previously unseen behind-the-scenes footage. Released to coincide with SOOBIN’s birthday, the film marks a special milestone in his artistic journey. Beyond the stage lights lies a story of pursuing dreams through hard work, pushing boundaries, and setting new standards. With the message "THE ALL-ROUNDER IS ALL AROUND YOU," SOOBIN expresses his gratitude to the audience - especially his fandom, KINGDOM - for their constant companionship and motivation along the way. Anyone, anywhere, can be an "All-Rounder."

title: Rapinoe
overview: Soccer star Megan Rapinoe explores what it means to win and lose in this intimate portrait.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 3
overview: The third night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 10, 2026, at Korakuen Hall in Tokyo, Japan.

title: Norton Creek Massacre
overview: It's 1998. Deep in the pine forests outside a sleepy North Carolina town in Norton Creek, A loner has spent his whole life dreaming of being a killer. His only real friend is Dron, a towering, near silent, monstrous juggernaut. Together they cause destruction on locals, and a group of vampires passing by.

title: Be Brave

overview: A fusion of the brilliantly choreographed stage spectacle of Pulp’s biggest ever arena show — part of the global tour for More, the band’s first album in 24 years — with four decades of colorful, never-seen-before archival material.

title: Happy Journey
overview: A group of seven women across generations set off on a spontaneous European getaway, leaving their everyday lives behind. Amid the chaos, laughter and picturesque landscapes, the journey becomes an unexpected celebration of freedom and friendship.

title: Edgar Allan Poe’s Murder Mystery Dinner Party: The Musical
overview: Edgar Allan Poe is throwing a murder mystery dinner party, and you’re invited—alongside his ghostly sidekick Lenore and a room full of famous authors, all with something to hide. But as the wine flows and the fake murders become real, guests start dropping like flies. Whodunnit? Why!? And who’s next?!!  Join literary legends from Mary Shelley and Lewis Carroll to Jane Austen and Oscar Wilde as they scramble to solve the mystery, protect their secrets, and defend their outsized egos.  Based on the hit web series, this brand-new musical serves up mystery, mayhem, and original songs in one delightfully deadly night of theatre.

title: Sick
overview: During the summer holidays, sixteen-year-old Maks and his older sister Emmaare sent to the Polish countryside to care for their ailing grandmother.  Trapped together in the heavy, stifling isolation of the summer heat, the siblings’ bond begins to shift into something unsettling and difficult to define. As tensions rise and boundaries begin to blur, their grandmother’s frail presence takes on an increasingly disturbing quality, turning a once-idyllic summer into a haunting passage into adulthood.

title: Embers
overview: Jasmine and Phoebe are at their breaking point. Will they keep on going or is this the end?

title: A Dead Man’s Genesis
overview: As her illustrated home slowly decays, a curious young girl living within the pages of a storybook searches for the truth behind the oppressive force erasing her world.

title: Piece
overview: A young soprano in the midst of his hormone replacement therapy must choose between preserving the voice that has long been part of who he is and fully embodying his identity as a man.

title: Ethel
overview: Ethel Berkowitz only wants to have a quiet afternoon prepping for Halloween, but when she is interrupted by her unhinged neighbor she is forced into a tense exchange which promises to push them both to their limits.

title: Brasifilia
overview: An essay film in which three young people unearth a clandestine archive of Brazilian cinema and plunge into a Dadaist–Third World delirium. Amid forbidden images and personal memories, they implode the very idea of Brazil.

title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
overview: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail.

title: Heart of the Beast
overview: After a harrowing plane crash, Special Forces officer James Belmont and his combat dog, Odin, find themselves stranded deep in the Alaskan wilderness. Together, they are forced into a brutal fight for survival against the elements.

title: Falling
overview: Alone in the suffocating quiet of his surrogate sister’s apartment, fifteen-year-old Analu clings desperately to memories of his lost loved one, Iolani, the one person who made him feel seen. The night becomes a battleground of haunting flashbacks and quiet suffering, as Analu teeters between holding on and letting go. Malu, his surrogate sister, fights to reach the part of him still holding on. Falling is a raw, intimate journey through trauma, where the weight of the past threatens to eclipse the connections that remain.

title: Dead Serious
overview: When a zombie outbreak descends upon a sleepy Midwestern town, a naive high school nerd must trek across the haunted rural wasteland in order to save his cheerleader crush from joining the undead.

title: Killer Ants
overview: A quiet community is thrown into terror when a deadly breed of ants begins spreading without warning. Small enough to go unnoticed and dangerous enough to overwhelm anyone in their path, the insects quickly turn familiar surroundings into a deadly trap.  As the infestation grows, survival becomes a race against an enemy that can enter almost anywhere. With the threat multiplying and escape becoming increasingly difficult, those caught in its path must find a way to stop the swarm before it consumes everything around them.

title: Sole Survivor of Flight 119
overview: After surviving a devastating plane crash deep in the Mexican jungle, sole survivor Lisa Foster must rely on her resourcefulness, inner strength and faith to endure the unforgiving wilderness and find her way home to her young daughter.

title: Denial
overview: A young man struggles with Bipolar Disorder as he begins a new job and flirtation.

title: NJPW Road to Destruction 2026 - Day 8
overview: The eighth night of Road to Destruction 2026 took place on September 19, 2026, at Kuribayashi Shokai Arena in Muroran City, Hokkaido, Japan.

title: Play House
overview: While renovating a dilapidated house to win back his ex, a young man discovers VHS tapes of an unaired TV show in the basement. But as the show’s dark history surfaces, it seeps into his life, threatening his last chance at reconciliation.

title: Sidelined
overview: A couple hosts a dinner to celebrate their recent engagement. But the inclusion of a distant sibling and their partner resurfaces family grievances and proves that some things are harder to share than a last name…

title: Ashes Again!
overview: Tabby and her dad are having their photograph taken, but Tabby refuses to smile: Dad doesn't even keep them - just sends them to her mum (wherever the hell she is).

title: Your Loss
overview: An AI Funeral Director offers advice and inspiration to the bereaved.

title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS
overview: Back after almost two years, NCT 127's fifth tour,  NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY : SEOUL - THE REDLINE’, is coming live to cinemas!  Experience the explosive energy, world-class performances, and electrifying atmosphere of KSPO DOME brought to life on the big screen with immersive sound.  NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

title: Ouroboros
overview: Jacot is a silent executioner: he kills, he carries out orders, he never fails at his task. When Perrin, an overly talkative guard, brings him a child to execute, he chooses to defy the royal order and lets the child escape.  Jacot must then face the consequences of his act: if he is found out, he will be condemned himself. He will have to cover his tracks and craft a lie so perfect that Perrin will believe it.

title: Silhouettes
overview: Franco lives with a mysterious presence that visits him during his sleepless nights. An unexpected encounter with Caro, a friend from his past, challenges the refuge he finds in that figure with the possibility of reconnecting with what's real.

title: Penance
overview: While traveling through an unsafe land, a Soldier and a Princess take shelter in a seemingly empty cavern.

title: Rexach. Correr es de Cobardes
overview: The film looks back at Rexach’s more than 45-year association with FC Barcelona, from his time as a youth player and first-team footballer to his work as a coach, sporting director, scout and presidential adviser. It focuses on his role in some of the club’s defining periods, particularly his relationship with Johan Cruyff, the success of the Dream Team, and his involvement in the discovery and signing of Lionel Messi.

title: Terms & Conditions
overview: A douchey techbro gets more than he bargained for when the genderqueer demon he used AI to summon sloughs off his control and sows chaos instead.

title: One Last Shot
overview: Navy Seal Jake Harris must stop a team of mercenaries, led by his disillusioned former comrade, from disabling the US missile defense network.

title: Masahe
overview: Alluring Zsara Laxamana takes center stage in Masahe, where she explores the sensual art of touch and the fantasies it can awaken. Discover intimate massage techniques that tease the senses, heighten desire, and turn every stroke into an unforgettable experience.

title: Fragmentos
overview: On the night she leaves, Natalia moves between the present and fragments of a love she once knew.

title: Todo lo que (no) nos dijimos anoche
Yowza! invalid
overview: A young woman confronts her father with a baseball bat concerning a rumor.

title: Catalunya-Madrid: La veritat de dos models econòmics
The Love Hypothesis
overview: Olive Smith, a biology PhD candidate, and Dr. Adam Carlsen, a hotshot professor and well-known tyrant, enter into a fake relationship, seeing each of their carefully calculated theories on love get thrown into chaos.

title: Primetime
overview: In 2006, To Catch a Predator host Chris Hansen sets out to make television history. When a high stakes operation goes fatally wrong, his veneered dream of fame curdles into a nightmare of performative justice.

title: Possible Love
overview: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.

title: Sense and Sensibility
overview: A charming, witty, and deeply relatable story of love and sisterhood.

title: The Scavenger
overview: When his aspiring-celebrity sister becomes trapped in a criminal scheme within an entertainment company, a devoted brother teams up with local police to uncover the truth and take down the powerful underworld behind it.

title: The Paradise
overview: In 1980s Secunderabad, a marginalized tribe battles discrimination and fights for citizenship under an unexpected leader's guidance, challenging systemic oppression.

title: Multwoh: Patay na Patay Sa'yo
overview: When a college queer dies suddenly in their dorm, they return as a ghost — not to seek revenge, but to say the one thing they never found the courage to say in life: "I love you".

title: Tazza: The Song of Beelzebub
overview: Jang Taeyoung, who believes he has everything after building a successful online casino business, loses it all to his former best friend and namesake, Park Taeyoung. The two reunite on the international poker circuit for a high-stakes battle of revenge.

title: Cop This
overview: It's Grand Final Day and in a suburban police station about to be replaced by an AI 'Terminal', the two remaining cops (Nicolette Minster and Ray O'Leary) are tasked with babysitting a drug dealer for 24 hours.

title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
overview: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

title: Another Day
overview: Garance is a young actress, but not a star. She manages everything as best she can, valiant, cheerful, a soldier, and she finds in alcohol an unconditional fuel, a source of comfort. Garance changes her life and begins an eight-year journey of moves, work, encounters, parties and anxieties, joys and hardships… An intimate, friendly, and sexual revolution. But she consumes, more and more. Until the very possibility of death…

title: The Assassin(s)
overview: In 1974, a shooting shocks South Korea. Detective Cheol-gu, who witnesses the attack, Jae-hwan, the city desk editor whose coverage is suppressed, and Young-il, a rookie reporter, begin to dig beneath the cover-up. As their pursuit of the truth deepens, they come to confront forces meant to remain unseen.

title: Shish Doo
overview: Over the course of one night, two friends, Adel and Nabil, find an unconscious wealthy young man and decide to kidnap him for ransom to escape poverty and despair. As events escalate, the kidnappers’ interests become entangled with the young man’s family and a powerful man who exploits his disappearance, revealing class conflicts, power struggles, and moral collapse.

title: Pinagkaisahan
overview: In a crowded public hospital, three women from different walks of life struggle against an oppressive system—each fighting for care, dignity, and the right to be seen.

title: Lines of Riga
overview: A portrait of a modern city. Documented and artistically interpreted life in Riga unfolds over a single summer day. Dynamic shifts between three main characters – a food courier, a tram driver, and a young girl – reveal the inhabitants’ daily trajectories and interactions with the city. A mosaic of intermittent scenes highlights nuances often lost in everyday routines, capturing the rhythm of the city and its rich urban life beyond the limits of the story.

title: Aninaw
overview: During the Battle of Bataan, a Filipino officer leading a routine patrol is forced into a deadly confrontation that tests his courage, leadership, and the true cost of duty.

title: Beast
overview: After a final harvest forced upon him by the landlord, an old farmer and his loyal carabao embark on a magical road trip to Manila, chasing the ghost of a niece the years stole from him.

title: Spidey and the Avengers: Halloween Team-Up!
overview: Spidey and the Avengers' Halloween plans are turned upside down by the mysterious Hallows' Eve, who plays magical tricks on trick or treaters and plans to ruin Halloween forever.

title: Charlie Harper
overview: The journey of two young souls, Charlie and Harper, as they meet, leave their respective homes, and attempt to build a life together in a new city. As the driven and ambitious Harper works to build a career as a chef, and the brilliant-yet-stuck Charlie struggles to get himself on track, their relationship faces growing challenges.

title: The Cycle
overview: A daughter unravels her father's dark past after his body, missing for 36 years, is found at a horrific crime scene.

title: Crawlers
overview: Tenants at Paradiso Palms apartments fight a deadly spider invasion while the cunning building manager might be their only hope for survival.

title: The Florist
overview: A quiet horticulturalist harboring a secret life as a lethal assassin finds his true identity jeopardized when he forms an unlikely friendship with a witnesses to police corruption.

title: A Clockwriter
overview: A screenwriter’s character manifests time, with each typewritten letter advancing the clock one minute closer to an encircling deadline.

title: Matchmaking 3
overview: The sequel to Matchmaking 2.

title: El patio
overview: During naptime at their grandfather's house, Julia and Matías play in the yard until Julia throws the ball into the neighboring property—owned by Ranamacho, a mysterious man who destroys any balls that land on his land. Caught between naivety and fear, the siblings' relationship becomes strained when Matías attempts to climb the wall to retrieve it.

title: Romanovs: Loyalty and Betrayal
overview: The film tells the story of the final years of the life of Nicholas II, the last emperor of Russia. It follows his devoted wife, Empress Alexandra; his son, Tsarevich Alexei; his daughters, Grand Duchesses Olga, Tatiana, Maria, and Anastasia; and his brother, Grand Duke Michael Alexandrovich. The love and loyalty of those closest to Nicholas accompanied him through the most difficult years of his life. But they could not protect him from betrayal. The treachery and cowardice of members of the Romanov dynasty, politicians of every kind, and generals who had sworn allegiance to the throne ultimately led to the collapse of the empire. The story of the imperial family unfolds against the backdrop of a tragic turning point in history.

title: Bloody Tennis
overview: Sophie joins a prestigious tennis academy, where the brutality of competitive sports is taken to its extreme and only the hungriest survive.

title: Memburu Pemangsa
overview: Following a localized string of youth abductions and homicides, a cynical newspaper editor forms a desperate alliance with a law enforcement officer and three investigative journalists to track a missing child, uncovering a malevolent force that forces them to choose between self-preservation and lethal sacrifice.

title: Ibadah & Cinta
overview: A secular young man raised in Australia undergoes a profound spiritual awakening after falling in love with the daughter of a prominent Islamic scholar, only for their matrimonial aspirations to be jeopardized by a pre-arranged betrothal mandated by her traditionalist family.

title: What Lies Between Us
overview: A quiet suburban community is shaken by the alleged sexual assault of a teenage boy by two of his peers. As the town reels, successful real estate agent Anne Sofie discovers her own son may be more involved than she imagined. Determined to protect him and the family's reputation, she makes a choice that sets her on a collision course with the other boys' mothers, Sarah and Ulrikke. As accusations against her son begin to spread, the pressure mounts and to shield her family, Anne Sofie pins the blame on one of the other boys. But as her relationships fracture and her moral compass wavers, she’s forced to make a life-altering decision.

title: The Whistler
overview: Reeling from their daughter's loss, Nicole and Sebastian come into possession of a secluded Venezuelan farm, unaware of the dark forces they're about to face.

title: Zona XYZ
overview: In an Amazonian city shrouded in smoke, the inmate Canijo agrees to sell the remainder of his sentence to a company in the Industrial District in exchange for a reduced term. Sent to the mysterious Collection Zones, he discovers that his imprisonment may extend far beyond the walls of a prison cell.

title: No Pain
overview: Davide’s life is turned upside down by a tragic event for which he bears an unwitting responsibility. Devastated by guilt, he is driven to a series of seemingly irrational choices that gradually lead him toward profound consequences. Yet, through his deep emotional bond with Elsa, Davide may still find an unexpected path to peace.

title: 100 Days
overview: 100 Days is a feature film about Brazilian explorer Amyr Klink, who crossed the South Atlantic Ocean in 1984. It blends adventure, family drama, and emotional flashbacks from his childhood and teen years.

title: Lovebox
overview: A society without money or competition: AfrikaBurn, the largest regional event inspired by the world-famous Burning Man, becomes the setting for a unique experiment. In the middle of the South African desert, an eclectic group of friends sets up their LOVEBOX spaceship, inviting visitors on a journey to the stars — and into themselves. Inside the LOVEBOX, two strangers meet for a few minutes and explore a question about love. Their encounters give rise to unexpected moments of connection and self-discovery. When the dust of the festival settles, the friends set out to bring the magic of the LOVEBOX into everyday life. But can the openness and sense of connection they experienced at AfrikaBurn survive beyond its temporary utopia?

title: UNABOMBER
overview: Follow Ted Kaczynski's transformation from Harvard prodigy into the infamous Unabomber. Subjected to controversial psychological experiments by Professor Henry Murray, Kaczynski's troubled past resurfaces decades later when his manhunt, led by FBI agent Joanne Miller, brings to light the chilling consequences of ambition and isolation.

title: Meesaya Murukku 2
overview: After facing rejection in love and getting into a fight, Jeeva learns about his father Siva's struggles and sacrifices. Inspired by his grandfather's legacy and father's dedication, Jeeva changes his outlook and works hard toward his musical dream. Through determination and perseverance, Jeeva earns recognition in the music industry and brings pride to his family.

title: Family
overview: A 10-year-old girl begins to believe her parents are trying to kill her. Convinced a sinister spirit is to blame, she spirals into a haunting fantasy world that mirrors her deepest fears.

title: LA BOLA NEGRA
overview: The intertwined lives of three men in three different eras, three lives intimately linked by sexuality and desire, pain, and legacy.

title: NAZA
overview: In secret conversations on the rooftops of Tel Aviv at night, the systems behind Israel's calculated mass killing of Palestinian civilians in Gaza are revealed by the people who designed and operated them.

title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother
overview: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

title: Stolen Heart
overview: A shy recovering kleptomaniac risks his sobriety when his crush encourages him to help her steal an artifact from a museum.

title: Premada Oorali
overview: Premada Oorali is a heartfelt love story set in picturesque villages in the 2020s. The film intertwines romance and family drama, exploring the relationships between a father and son, as well as a boy and girl, as they navigate through intriguing, yet relatable, relationship challenges.

title: The Deputy
overview: A young sheriff's deputy finds himself in the crosshairs of dangerous criminals when the dead body he is assigned to keep an eye on disappears from a crime scene.

title: Love Lottery
overview: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

title: Don't Be Shy!
overview: Quintessential Mean Girl, Shyamili ‘Shy’ Das, finds herself suddenly relegated to Loser-ville when Mayank, her boyfriend of three years, suddenly dumps her. But Shy, all set to get her revenge, finds herself falling into friendship and compassion with someone unexpected… Mayank’s new girlfriend - Tara.

title: Dorothy
overview: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

title: Buzzkill
overview: A group of sorority sisters end up trapped with a murderer. Nora’s tipsy memories hold the clues to figuring out who is killing their friends, but she can only remember them when she’s drunk.

title: Peppa Pig: Perfect Holiday
overview: When Peppa learned that her family wouldn't be going on vacation this year, she was very disappointed. However, a sudden storm transported her to faraway China! Peppa embarked on a wonderful adventure until she was reunited with her family, and Peppa had the perfect vacation ever.

title: Attention Seeker
overview: The Powers, a picturesque family. David Powers, a classic country singer with a comeback album on the horizon works away with his tools on the grounds of the estate. Janet Powers, the matriarch of the house toiling away in the kitchen preparing a feast for the family. Ben Powers, buried amongst the various computer windows of gameplay, text chats, and live streaming feeds. And Grace, dejected with a black eye starring into old pictures of days when she thought she was happy. One click is all it would take, it wouldn't undo any of what she's been through, and yeah it would probably make it all worse, she'd be attacked by everyone, the whole family would. A single click on the 'publish' button, and everything would come out, everything about her father, what it's like to live in this house. 'Why not' she thinks, 'I won't be here to see it, burn it all down'.

title: The Journey of Heroes
overview: The Journey of Heroes follows Ny (Steven Nguyễn), who, after rescuing his younger sister from a human trafficking ring along the Western border, is captured alongside his best friend and forced into slavery inside a brutal scam compound. There, together with undercover investigators and fellow victims suffering in silence, they secretly devise a daring plan to escape.

title: Cascarrabias
overview: When Chava returns home to care for his ailing father, bitter truths lead them to a point of no return.

title: Hope Street: One of Our Own
overview: A violent crime committed against a much-loved local and the police investigation brings bad news for DS Marlene Pettigrew. Love is also in the air and there’s a wedding to plan, but this is Port Devine, what could possibly go wrong?

title: Kraken
overview: In a housing project, an abandoned tower fuels rumors. As strange disappearances multiply, five young people have no choice but to enter once again. Trapped in a deadly snare, they will soon realize that escaping will be impossible…

title: Slåtter
overview: The short film premieres as part of World Affairs’ exhibition "Collected Works 2016–2026" by Jonatan Leandoer Håstad.

title: Arctic Annihilation
overview: An earthquake in the Atlantic triggers a devastating drop in global temperatures, plunging the world into a deadly, apocalyptic ice age.

title: The Stunt Driver
overview: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

title: Untitled The Patrick Star Show Mini-Series
overview: A Mini-Series from the fifth season of The Patrick Star Show containing the episodes "Gone Bootin'," Roller Bunny," "Squ-AD-ina," "Don't Friend the Reaper," "Pat Alone... At Home" and "Seagull Scout Adventures."

title: Other Half
overview: After cheating on her girlfriend, Jade (Grace Rolek) finds herself isolated in a world of newfound heart break. Determined to suffer through the grieving process alone, she refuses to answer calls, texts or communicate with friends and family. In her booze-soaked depression, Jade attempts to rediscover what being alone really means. With no one to blame but herself, she indulges in self-destructive behavior to cope. Despite her attempts to ignore her estranged best friend Avery (Cleopatra Boudreau), Jade is surprised to find her showing up at her door and entering (well, stampeding) into her space. What unfolds is a night of reckoning and rediscovery of their friendship.

title: Strindbergs Ensam
overview: Based on Strindberg's autobiographical book of the same name. Is it better to self isolate than to put in all the work it takes to maintain a social life?

title: We Are Aliens
overview: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.

title: Phantom Carousel
overview: A broke gig worker moonlights as a corporate spy, hunting remote workers across London for productivity crimes. But when a routine audit goes wrong, he must decide how far he'll go to stay employable.

title: Mahakavya: Shri Ramayan Katha
overview: A futuristic drama based on the story of the great epic Ramayana with the emotional filming and presentation of the events of Shri Ram's life which has never been seen on screen till now.

title: Mission D.D.L.J.
overview: Diya dreams of a fairy tale love story like Dilwale Dulhaniya Le Jayenge & Dhrubo doesn’t belive in classic love. Eventually life brings them to a point, where they both have to come together & follow the paths.

title: Where the Hell Is Anna?
overview: When her estranged best friend Anna mysteriously vanishes into a women-only retreat in the woods, messy and heartbroken Derick crashes the culty pagan commune determined to bring her home. But the longer she stays, the harder it gets to tell who’s healing and who’s brainwashed. As the Summer Solstice nears and Anna is chosen for a “ceremony” called Induction Day, Derick uncovers disturbing secrets buried beneath the flower crowns and sisterhood mantras, including blood rituals, fertility experiments, and the looming promise of paradise known as Summerland.

title: First Time?
overview: A boozy Friday night hangout turns sour once a scarring memory takes control.

title: Invention 13
overview: On a cold, windy night, a frustrated pianist encounters strange obstacles while trying to learn  Bach's notoriously intricate Invention 13.

title: Burdened
overview: After a tragic car crash leaves their mother in a coma, 19-year-old Dakota is forced into adulthood as she becomes the primary caregiver for her younger brother, Zach, a young boy struggling with severe ADHD. Torn between grief, guilt, and her own stalled future, she must decide how much of herself she can give without disappearing.

title: Wingclipper
overview: Stardust, a young wife and mother, suffocates in the perfect, yet male-centric Funcyland. Through reveries, she is led to extreme actions in search of her true self, outside her golden cage.

title: AEW All Out 2026
overview: The 2026 All Out was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by All Elite Wrestling (AEW) that took place on September 26, 2026, at the NOW Arena in Hoffman Estates, Illinois, USA. The show was headlined by an AEW World Title match between current Champion Will Ospreay and challenger Jon Moxley.

title: Perfect Princess
overview: Reluctantly donning princess regalia and delivering cupcakes, Chad stumbles through an ill-fated day - only to discover that leaving with nothing might be pretty sweet.

title: Koplopers
overview: When five football hooligans from the south of the Netherlands take part in a social experiment, a confrontational group game exposes hidden vulnerabilities and challenges their loyalty, leading the group to unravel.

title: Metamorphosis
overview: For their graduation project, Lisa spends two weeks living in a terrarium. As her behavior changes more and more, her classmate Victor must decide how far he is willing to go for the sake of their art.

title: Midnight Drop
overview: It’s November 8th, 2004—and Halo 2 drops at midnight, a night that will go down in gaming history. Best friends Adam and Tone are gearing up for an unforgettable all-nighter, but their plans go off the rails when two suburban punks hold up their local GameStop. What was supposed to be an epic night of gaming quickly turns into a chaotic hostage standoff.

title: Children of the Sun
overview: Four friends from Berlin spend their summer in Greece trying to free themselves of all societal norms and conventions. They throw away their phones, open their relationships and begin to question all mental and physical limits in search of freedom. But just as their newfound utopia unfolds, forest fires erupt around their camp. The four friends realize that they might have to leave the country and above all, their youthful ideals behind.

title: Gebroken hart
overview: While her schoolfriends look forward to adulthood, eighteen-year-old Tasnim struggles with the consequences of her donor heart, which means hospital visits between exams, and sometimes having to scale back her dreams for the future.

title: Obscure Identity
overview: In an era of sensory overload and conspiracy, the line between truth and delusion is razor thin. When a woman is stuck in the liminal space of an airport baggage claim, she must know the difference before paranoia (or worse) consumes her.

title: Бэркэ
overview: The small village of Khatystyr in the forests of southern Yakutia has long been considered the land of the Evenki. Recently, popular ethnobloggers have emerged here, sharing stories of Tungus culture with hundreds of thousands of followers online. Timofey Ivanovich is over sixty. He is a wolf hunter, and so he adopted the online pseudonym Berke (Evenk for "wolf"). Berke is an old-timer, a keeper of traditions, respected and called upon at crucial moments. Now such a moment has arrived: the wolves have returned. Hungry packs are crushing reindeer and moving toward the village. Berke ventures alone into the taiga to drive off the predators. In his real world, he has only a rifle and a video camera. And in his virtual world, there are millions of views and thousands of comments. This is the story of how a keeper of national myths saves his small people from the scourge of wolves, and ultimately becomes a new folk legend himself.

title: Il mio nome è Carlo
overview: The movie traces three key moments: the six-year-old boy, already driven by an extraordinary spiritual sensitivity; the eleven-year-old boy, curious and brilliant; and the fifteen-year-old in his first year of high school, self-aware and determined, capable of approaching everyday life with an extraordinary outlook.

title: Erva
overview: Someone is living in Erva's house... Wandering around, eating her food from the fridge, rearranging her belongings, and even sleeping in her bed while she's away.

title: Sundown
overview: Joakim, a young, compassionate caregiver working in a dementia Ward, navigates the emotional toll of his work as he learns to accept the limits of his ability to help.

title: Bad Look
overview: After her first nude photo shoot, an ambitious model becomes unsettled by the way a well-known photographer has framed and interpreted her body. When she confronts him to regain control of the images, their negotiation spirals into a charged argument that exposes the power and insecurity underlying their collaboration.

title: No One Leaves
overview: When Meredith and her husband go to have dinner with their neighbor on the next farm over, he introduces them to his visiting niece. But as the evening progresses, Meredith begins to suspect that this young woman isn't his niece, but his captive.

title: RW-LO
overview: Martine Syms blends recreations with home movies from the life of Brent David Freaney, a lifelong pop girlie who was once, as vintage camcorder footage reveals, a Deep South teenager obsessed with outspoken The Real World: New Orleans castmate Melissa Howard. RW-LO is a nostalgic—and surprising—inquiry into what happens when people start being celebrities, and they stop being real.

title: Kill. Bury. Print.
overview: When the McCurtain Gazette, a small family-run newspaper, begins reporting on alleged sex, drugs, and violence within the county sheriff's office, they find themselves the target of the sheriff's retaliation. Tensions escalate when the paper obtains a secret recording revealing the sheriff and local officials allegedly discussing having the family killed, turning a local investigation into international news.

title: Sevda
overview: Successful real estate agent Sevda is on the verge of closing a major project in Istanbul. However, just before construction is set to begin, she encounters an unexpected obstacle: an old Ottoman cemetery and its elderly caretaker who refuses to leave.

title: Digger
overview: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

title: BOMBAY STORIES
overview: Adapted from the short stories of Pakistani writer Saadat Hasan Manto, the film interweaves the lives of three sex workers and their pimps.

title: Death Whisperer: Saming the Werebeast
overview: Follows the search for a missing military officer in the jungle of Khao Khwang, where legend says man-eating tiger spirit Saming takes human form in 1960s Thailand.

title: The Nice Ones
overview: When Kate joins her boyfriend’s friends at a remote countryside retreat, old wounds resurface as strange lights appear in the sky. As unease grows, members of the group begin to change—becoming unnervingly calm, kind, and “nice.” Dismissed as unstable, Kate struggles to convince the others something is wrong before the force behind it spreads.

title: La jangada
overview: La Jangada is the union of 35 musicians embraced by nature with a common goal: to bring to life songs that are born from the heart of this country.  In search of the vastness that these songs convey, we wanted to bring a piece of Santiago del Estero's land straight to the Río de La Plata.

title: Ghost Light
overview: Actress Marion Neal finds herself mired in a lawsuit over the rights to her playhouse. As strange occurrences begin to take place, the hidden truth emerges regarding an intricate web of interwoven conspiracies and villainous agendas.

title: gala
overview: a group of people, all united by the same love. we are family for a night. we smile, we take care of each other. jumping, punching, spitting and bleeding. moshing.

title: Farewell
overview: A short film for NOTODO Film Fest.  In 1936, a man tries to flee his home in secret. But his daughter crosses his path before he can step through the doorway.

title: The Swan: Behind the Mirror
overview: A look at the controversial 2004 reality series The Swan, which took self-proclaimed 'ugly ducklings' and set out to make them... not that.

title: Crooked Miles
overview: Desperate people receive a mystical gift that grants wishes, collects souls, and creates monsters.

title: Love - Love
overview: LOVE - LOVE is the story of two brothers : Andy, who suffers from schizophrenia, and Jeff, an actor in search of success and meaning in his life. After the death of their grandmother, Andy is left without a « caretaker ». Refusing to live in a group home, he insists on moving in with their father, Bruce, whom they lost touch with after he fled his responsibilities. The two brothers then set out on a road trip to find their father, a disgraced former professional tennis player, now living in seclusion near the Salton Sea, in the California desert.

title: How Much Time
overview: During the Christmas season, six 29-year-old friends reunite at the funeral of a former schoolmate, almost ten years after they last saw each other. As they confront their unresolved lives, doubts and fears, their reunion becomes a portrait of a generation caught between the end of youth and an uncertain future.

title: Verity
overview: Lowen Ashleigh is hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who is unable to finish following an accident. Lowen gradually uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

title: Livestream from Hell
overview: When Kevin Hart teams up with fellow comedian, Druski, and streamer, Kai Cenat for a record-breaking livestream at his tech-savvy mansion, things go hilariously off the rails, until the pranks turn to panic, and a real murder mystery unfolds on camera, trapping the trio and their celebrity guests in a high-stakes, horror-comedy whodunnit watched by millions.

title: The Widower: 'Til Death Do Us Part
overview: A journalist and a detective uncover the truth about a killer whose charm masked a trail of failed marriages and suspicious deaths.

title: Reawakened Man
overview: Despite unwavering support from his best friend Young-ha and the unwavering support of his younger sister Ye-rin, job seeker Seok Hwan just can't seem to land a job, repeatedly failing interviews. One night, after yet another disastrous interview, he returns home only to be attacked by a group of strangers and killed. But 72 hours after his death, Seok Hwan suddenly opens his eyes as if nothing happened. He soon discovers that he possesses a special ability: no matter how many times he dies, he comes back to life. But there's little time to process his extraordinary new power before a mysterious figure known as Black, who has discovered Hwan's existence, begins hunting him down.  Yet with each resurrection, Seok Hwan grows stronger, unleashing powers beyond anything he could have imagined!

title: WWE/AAA Worlds Collide 2026: Chicago
overview: The 2026 Worlds Collide, also promoted as Worlds Collide: Chicago, was a professional wrestling live event co-produced by WWE and its sister promotion AAA. It was the sixth Worlds Collide under the WWE banner and the third between both promotions. It was filmed on September 26, 2026, at Allstate Arena in Rosemont, Illinois, USA, but aired on September 30.

title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
overview: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

title: A Man of His Time
overview: September 1940. Henri Marre arrives alone in Vichy as the authoritarian regime settles in. Broke, estranged from his family, and carrying copies of his self-published manifesto Notre Salut (Our Salvation), the 49-year-old is determined to secure what he believes is his rightful place in the new administration. In his writing, Henri sets out his patriotic convictions and his engineer’s methodology: efficiency above all. Claiming he wants to help save France after defeat, he does whatever is required to remain useful, serving the machinery of the new order with increasing skill. But he may be pursuing something more urgent: escape from his own ruin

title: Atomic Eve
overview: In the year 2029, the world is at war. As announcements of incoming nuclear attack shake the United States, people of all walks of life scramble to reconcile with the end of the world.

title: MORPHISM
overview: Eleven-year-old Kaat visits the Stavros family for the first time; a peculiar family of scientists where everyone, including the dog, suffers from a horrible wasp allergy. Blown away by the family, Kaat pushes her own boundaries further and further as an experimental subject.

title: Always Yours, Never Mine
overview: Across thirty years, several almosts, and timing that is never quite right, two people keep crossing paths – always on the verge of being together, but never quite making it.

title: The Doll
overview: Wealthy merchant Stanislaw Wokulski falls tragically in love with beautiful yet vain Izabela Lecka. His unfulfilled love leads to many foolish decisions sealing his fate.

title: Drury Lane
overview: A flat tire leaves realtor James stranded on the side of the road. He’s now at the mercy of a stranger who finds himself on the same road, on the same night, at the same time…

title: Bitter Sweet
overview: After two girl's friendship falls apart days before Christmas, one of the girls decides to rekindle their friendship through the sweetest gift.

title: Escape at Alcatraz
overview: When a covert black-ops contractor seizes Alcatraz, the CIA smuggles hardened agent Lt. Jack Callahan inside to extract whistleblower Anya Turner and her damning evidence before the mission spirals into a deadly fight for survival.
